title: BCZ YapZ w/Yoni Dubz
summary: BetterCallZaal sits down with Yoni Dubz, streamer, musician, and digital storyteller, for a deep talk about live creation, community, and the discipline behind staying consistent online. They explore how streaming turned from a side project into a core creative outlet, how to balance being entertaining and authentic, and why Web3 gives artists real control over their content. Yoni breaks down how he builds connections through Twitch and Retake, why every viewer matters, and what it takes to keep momentum when no one’s watching yet.
